summary: Trinity and Neo, in long black coats, push through the revolving doors into the government building lobby, Neo carrying a duffel bag and Trinity a large metal suitcase, drawing nervous glances as they cross to the security station. Neo calmly walks through the metal detector, which immediately wails; a guard asks him to remove metallic items, but Neo instead sets down his bag, throws open his coat to reveal an arsenal of guns, knives and grenades on a climbing harness, and in a blur kills three guards before they hit the floor. A fourth guard dives for cover and radios for backup, then looks up to see Trinity set off the metal detector and is killed. Backup arrives as a wave of soldiers blocking the elevators, turning the concrete lobby into a roar of gunfire with explosive-tipped bullets cratering the walls, answered by Neo and Trinity's sub-hand machine gun and throwing knives, used with deadly precision. Bodies slump to the marbled floor while the two hardly break their stride.

what_changes.before: Two armed figures moving through a lobby under routine, passive security screening.
what_changes.after: The lobby becomes a battlefield where they have killed the guards and soldiers and press on unharmed.
what_changes.evidence: The concrete cavern of the lobby becomes a white noise ROAR of GUNFIRE. ... Bodies slump down to the marbled floor while Neo and Trinity hardly even break their stride.

what_changes.before: In control of the checkpoint, able to issue a routine order to Neo.
what_changes.after: Three killed instantly and a fourth killed after his call for backup fails to save him.
what_changes.evidence: In a split second, three guards are dead before they hit the ground. A fourth guard dives for cover, clutching his radio.

what_changes.before: Able to summon reinforcements to contain the intruders at the elevators.
what_changes.after: The backup soldiers are cut down by Neo and Trinity's weapons fire.
what_changes.evidence: The backup arrives. A wave of soldiers blocking the elevators. ... They are met by the quivering spit of a SUB-HAND MACHINE GUN and the RAZORED WHISTLE of throwing knives.

event_hint.one_line: Neo and Trinity storm the government building lobby, gunning down guards and soldiers to fight their way inside.

objects_that_matter: arsenal of guns, knives and grenades
uncertain: Whether Neo and Trinity reach the elevators or Morpheus within this scene.
The exact number of soldiers killed beyond what is described.

minds.wants: To clear the lobby fast and reach the elevators, converting himself from a suspect at a checkpoint into the leading edge of the rescue.
minds.feels: A cold, deliberate certainty. He is no longer trying to pass as ordinary; he has committed to being seen as a threat, and the commitment reads as calm rather than fear.
minds.shows: The 'game face' — dark glasses, unhurried movements, the slow setting-down of the bag and the deliberate opening of the coat. He lets the detector wail and the guard's order hang rather than comply.
minds.basis: He 'calmly' passes through the detector, sets the bag down slowly, and opens his coat with theatrical deliberation before moving 'in a blur.' The scene notes his weapons are used 'like extensions of their bodies.' ev-026 has him requesting the arsenal, so this is the first use of what he chose.

believes_about.belief: They are an obstacle to be neutralized, not people to be negotiated with.
believes_about.wrong_because: He treats them as pure function, but their deaths are what will summon the soldiers — they are already shaping the fight he thinks he is simply executing.

believes_about.belief: That he can walk through this unharmed.
believes_about.wrong_because: inferred — the soldiers with explosive-tipped rounds are the first real test of that certainty, and the scene cannot yet confirm it will hold.

minds.wants: The same breach as Neo, executed as one unit with him, refusing the role of backup or passenger.
minds.feels: Resolved and synchronized. ev-026 established that she chose this mission over Neo's objection, so her presence here is an assertion of that choice as much as a tactical move.
minds.shows: She mirrors Neo's game face and stride, carrying the metal suitcase and setting off her own detector — the kill of Guard #4 happens almost as a byproduct of her continuing forward, not as a pause.
minds.basis: She walks 'hardly even break[ing] their stride' in lockstep with Neo; her detector trips and Guard #4 dies in the same breath. ev-026 has her invoke rank to join despite Neo's doubts, making this the proof-of-competence she is staking.

believes_about.belief: That she has already answered his doubt by being here and performing.
believes_about.wrong_because: inferred — she may believe the demonstration settles the rank dispute from ev-026, but the coming events will keep testing whether they move as equals.

believes_about.belief: That they are the same kind of threat the guards were — manageable at her pace.
believes_about.wrong_because: The explosive-tipped rounds and the 'wave' of soldiers are a categorically heavier engagement than the checkpoint; her stride assumes a parity the scene has not yet confirmed.

minds.wants: To complete a routine screening and move these two odd-looking visitors along.
minds.feels: A flicker of unease beneath the script — they read as wrong, but he has no framework for how wrong until it is too late.
minds.shows: Polite procedure: he moves in with the wand and recites the standard line about keys and loose change.
minds.basis: His dialogue is boilerplate checkpoint language ('Would you please remove any metallic items'), delivered while Neo is already deciding to reveal the arsenal.

believes_about.belief: That he is a compliant civilian who will empty his pockets when asked.
believes_about.wrong_because: The coat opens onto an arsenal; his expectation of a routine interaction is exactly what leaves him dead before he hits the ground.

minds.wants: To survive by getting help on the radio and getting low.
minds.feels: Pure survival panic — the first of his group to grasp that this is not a screening but an ambush.
minds.shows: He dives for cover and shouts for backup, then looks up — a reflexive need to see the threat he is reporting.
minds.basis: He 'dives for cover, clutching his radio' and calls 'Backup! Send in the backup!' His death coincides with looking up at Trinity tripping the detector.

believes_about.belief: That calling for reinforcements will save him — that the system will respond in time.
believes_about.wrong_because: The backup arrives, but he is already dead as it does; the cavalry is what Neo and Trinity then slaughter, not what rescues him.

believes_about.belief: inferred — that the second figure is a secondary threat or an afterthought while he deals with Neo.
believes_about.wrong_because: She is the immediate cause of his death; his attention and his gun are oriented toward Neo's side of the fight.

minds.wants: To contain the two intruders at the elevators and stop the breach.
minds.feels: inferred — the confidence of a mass response: a 'wave' sent to overwhelm what a single guard could not hold.
minds.shows: They arrive as a blocking force at the elevators and open fire with explosive-tipped rounds.
minds.basis: The summary states backup 'arrives... A wave of soldiers blocking the elevators,' and they bring heavier weaponry than the guards had.

believes_about.belief: That two people, however armed, can be pinned down and stopped by overwhelming firepower in an open lobby.
believes_about.wrong_because: Their precision and synchronization turn the open space into a kill zone against the soldiers themselves; numbers do not translate into the advantage the soldiers assume.

connects_back: ev-026: Neo and Trinity's request for and receipt of the arsenal is the loadout being deployed here for the first time.
ev-026: Trinity's decision to override Neo's objection and join the mission is what puts her at Neo's side in this breach rather than waiting behind.
sc-154: Tank's 'They're coming for you' to the dying Morpheus frames this assault as the answer to that promise — the rescue is now in motion.
sc-153: Smith's desperation to get inside Zion and his torture of Morpheus establish the clock this lobby-crossing is racing against.
sets_up: ev-027: The cleared path to the elevators makes possible boarding one, rigging it as a bomb, and riding the counterweights to the roof.
ev-027: The soldiers' explosive-tipped ammunition and the two-on-many firefight establish the lethal rhythm that carries up through the building.
ev-028: Reaching the roof sets up Trinity piloting the helicopter into the executive office to extract Morpheus.
ev-029: The rooftop escape and the Agents' pursuit are made necessary by the very public, body-leaving breach that begins in this lobby.
dramatic_function: To convert the crew's debate and preparation into irreversible action — the rescue is no longer argued, it is underway — and to establish Neo and Trinity as a synchronized, nearly unstoppable force so that the coming escalation with soldiers and Agents reads as earned rather than asserted.
